principle: Generated content is never authoritative automatically. Machine activity can move a record no higher than candidate_needs_source_verification for external-authority content, or candidate for self-contained content.

states.note: Highest state a machine may assign, and only to a record whose evidenceBasis is SELF_CONTAINED.
Charter section XIV. The state every EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY record generated without a verified source must carry.

reviewerRule: A machine identity cannot be a registered reviewer and cannot record a review. authoredBy for machine-generated content must be 'machine:<agent-id>'.
